scope: Read-only production-source review and independent verification of the existing R02 diagnostic recovery receipt. Only this review file was written by the reviewer.
candidateCommitMeaning: The implementation was inspected as a working-tree candidate. Exact file hashes above identify the review; no unpublished source was treated as a completed build.

decision.rationale: The four-pose diagnostic does not locate a visible geometric fold at a single solver phase. It does show that the broad pale inner sidewall changes under a same-geometry native oral-material experiment. Restoring the lost oral-skin material responsibility is a justified bounded candidate. Keep native geometry, contacts and R02 coarse-relief inheritance intact.

innerLipSourceChecks.subject: Matched R04 / R02 comparison
innerLipSourceChecks.evidence: compare(mode) validates r04/r02, preserves the already-active R02 base, and changes comparison plus liEnabled/liDiagnostic through sync() and viewer.render(). It does not call model.compute(), viewer.update(), a geometry setter, or the native lip solver for a matched R02-base toggle.
innerLipSourceChecks.condition: The base must already be R02. A transition from a legacy R07 archive calls the inherited priorCompare(r02), which can restore the ancestor R02 relief scale and update display geometry. The current report qualifies this instead of declaring every transition geometry-invariant.

innerLipSourceChecks.subject: Native pose and camera ownership
innerLipSourceChecks.evidence: pose(name) uses the existing window.lipWorkbench.stop/setPose APIs on the current person; view(kind) delegates to the existing captured R02 base.view. There is no model allocation or geometry import. Default startup uses native jawOpen 0.36 and the native macro view.

innerLipSourceChecks.subject: Archive ancestry and recursion
innerLipSourceChecks.evidence: controller.archive and controller.restore are bound before installing the new aliases. R04 archive calls that captured R02 function and appends innerLip. The retained R02 function already captured the complete body/head/native ancestry. Current API aliases call controller.archive/restore dynamically exactly once. The prior functions do not call the new aliases, so the proposed route has no recursive archive cycle.

innerLipSourceChecks.subject: Complete current-person save routing
innerLipSourceChecks.evidence: Native fullCommonWorkbench/controller aliases, R02 base, head and body APIs all route to the current controller archive. body.save is redirected. A shell capture listener intercepts the retained R02/head/body save closures before their descendants execute; retained load controls and file inputs use currentRestore. Native top-level actions call the current controller dynamically. The new R04 save serializes the full currentArchive rather than a lip-only object.
innerLipSourceChecks.runtimeLimit: Actual download equality and archive round-trip on the compiled candidate remain runtime gates; this review establishes the intended source route.

innerLipSourceChecks.subject: R04 validation before person mutation
innerLipSourceChecks.evidence: Input must be a non-array object. hasOwnProperty controls innerLip presence; only an own field is read. Explicit null, false, zero, empty string, undefined, arrays and other non-object own values are rejected. Schema, version, implementation, comparison and diagnostic are validated before structuredClone and before priorRestore(copy). A legacy archive with no own innerLip uses the inherited path with R04 disabled.

innerLipSourceChecks.subject: Ancestor protocol scope
innerLipSourceChecks.evidence: R04 adds one kaopu/lip-inner@1 field and removes only that field before passing the clone to the captured R02 restore. The existing lipRealism schema, calibration data, head/body/native archive fields and their validation remain inherited. R04 does not migrate PR305 protocols or interpret PR307 state.

innerLipSourceChecks.subject: Invalid comparison input has no partial switch
innerLipSourceChecks.evidence: The replacement base.compare checks the inherited r01/r02/r07 enumeration before changing comparison or calling sync. Invalid mode therefore throws before changing the R04 uniform state.

resolvedSourceIssues.issue: Truthy-only innerLip validation skipped explicit falsy fields
resolvedSourceIssues.fix: Separate own-field presence from value; reject malformed present fields before calling priorRestore.
resolvedSourceIssues.reason: A malformed R04 archive must not mutate the person and then silently behave like a legacy file.

resolvedSourceIssues.issue: An inherited innerLip property could bypass own-field validation but still be applied
resolvedSourceIssues.reason: Direct restore API calls and JSON restoration now use the same definition of absent legacy state.

resolvedSourceIssues.issue: Invalid base.compare mode disabled R04 before ancestor validation threw
resolvedSourceIssues.fix: Validate mode before changing comparison or uniforms.
resolvedSourceIssues.reason: A rejected request should leave the held comparison unchanged.

resolvedSourceIssues.issue: The geometry-invariance report was unconditional across legacy base transitions
resolvedSourceIssues.fix: Report false only for an R02 base, otherwise null, and explicitly document restoring inherited R02 relief from legacy R07.
resolvedSourceIssues.reason: The normal matched comparison is uniform-only, while a version ancestry transition has a different scope.

shaderSourceChecks.subject: Semantic domain
shaderSourceChecks.evidence: liOral = clamp(vL19State.x,0,1) * clamp(vCSRegion.x,0,1) * (1-step(0.5,vCSType)); liWeight additionally requires liEnabled and the actual native uLEnabled. It uses the continuous inherited oral-skin semantic, not a camera-space region, exterior lip silhouette or newly classified triangles.
shaderSourceChecks.limit: Fractional native oral-skin weights are intentional transition coverage. The source does not establish a new anatomical boundary.

shaderSourceChecks.subject: Upper / lower identity
shaderSourceChecks.evidence: The helper derives upper from the midpoint of lrInnerTop/lrInnerBottom at vFRest.x and vFRest.y. R02 rail() and native F5 jl() use the same inherited Hermite rail interpolation. U5 assigns lower values to x and upper values to y for melanin, blood, roughness and wetness. The candidate uses that ordering. It does not rely on incomplete vL19Detail.z on deep oral vertices.

shaderSourceChecks.subject: Native parameter ownership
shaderSourceChecks.evidence: The original live native uniform objects are required rather than synthesized. The helper only adds its two uniform handles, preserves native references/values, and publishes the new fragment only after every anchor check succeeds. The outer wrapper independently captures and checks the native object identities during compilation.

shaderSourceChecks.subject: Palette and response endpoint
shaderSourceChecks.evidence: pcBase is the existing C2 pcBoundary pre-lip base in linear light. F5/U5 supply the selected melanin/blood/oxygen, upper/lower tone, mucosa tint, contact, roughness, coat and bounded depth expressions. The candidate composites this endpoint once by liWeight. Exterior atlas, dry patches, decorative mottling and outer-fade code were deliberately not copied.
shaderSourceChecks.limit: These inherited appearance coefficients are not measured tissue optics. The same-geometry material ablation did not independently isolate which of color, coat, height or depth contributed how much.

shaderSourceChecks.subject: R02 off guard
shaderSourceChecks.evidence: With liEnabled=0 and liDiagnostic=0, liWeight is zero. No new psBase, psR, psH, clearcoat or outgoingLight assignment executes. The inherited shader code and native uniforms remain present.
shaderSourceChecks.limit: Changing the compiled fragment can affect compiler output; only the actual same-scene GPU/frame comparison can establish exact R02 pixel equality. This source review does not substitute for that gate.

shaderSourceChecks.subject: Geometric and derivative ownership
shaderSourceChecks.evidence: The only height edit is psH *= 1-liWeight before inherited dFdx/dFdy normal evaluation. There is no vertex shader assignment, mesh attribute/index/group change or native geometric normal write. This fades the inherited shader height field out of oral-skin responsibility while retaining true geometric folds.
shaderSourceChecks.limit: Height derivatives have ordinary adjacent fragment-quad support. It would be inaccurate to claim every pixel at zero oral weight is necessarily bit-identical to R02 if its derivative neighbors cross the transition. No arbitrary visual threshold is introduced here.

shaderSourceChecks.subject: Mouth depth stays on oral skin
shaderSourceChecks.evidence: vL19Detail.w is used only inside liWeight>0, in the inherited bounded .12+.88*exp(-max(0,w)*120) expression. It cannot directly modify outer-skin color where liWeight is zero, and the csType guard excludes teeth/gums/tongue from this shared-skin candidate.
shaderSourceChecks.limit: w is a normalized native mouth-forward depth proxy, not measured optical path length or tissue thickness. The retained original material handles teeth/gums/tongue independently.

shaderSourceChecks.subject: Diagnostic independence
shaderSourceChecks.evidence: The purple identity view uses liOral independent of liEnabled and uLEnabled, after earlier diagnostics and before opaque_fragment. It therefore identifies the same inherited oral-skin region in both comparison modes. It is a semantic view, not a pass/fail heatmap.

shaderAnchorOrder: R07 native vertex-contract and procedural fragment hook
Frozen R02 declaration/rail helpers and final color/height/roughness composite
R04 pure mucosa color/roughness and psH attenuation at retained roughnessFactor=psR anchor
Inherited material initialization and frozen R02 clearcoat block
R04 clearcoat override immediately before lights_fragment_begin
R04 bounded oral-depth visibility before all existing psView diagnostics
Optional R04 oral identity diagnostic before opaque_fragment

evidence: Build reads the frozen R02 preview and checks its full-byte SHA256 before appending.
Each appended module is parsed as JavaScript and rejects an embedded closing script token.
The two modules and source metadata are appended before the last closing body tag.
Removing the exact suffix must recover the original R02 string.
The sequence of inherited script hashes must remain exactly equal.
Build manifest retains baseline source/build hashes and marks visual acceptance and production readiness false.

independentDiagnosticRecoveryReview.meaning: The amended diagnostic recovery has actual strict state/frame/after-frame evidence. It resolves the diagnostic restoration failure without changing any of the six geometry/material attribution images. It is not a runtime verification or visual acceptance of the new production shader candidate.

firstFailureRetained.failure: Original final restoration differed in nine serialized leaves: exposure and two lights/targets. The original run remains failed and its review/evidence are not rewritten.

remainingRuntimeGatesForCandidate: Compile the actual inherited shader in the actual viewer; preserve the pre-R04 and final fragment evidence and verify real GPU link.
Prove native uniform identities and geometry/attribute/index/group invariants on the held same-person scene.
Prove that liEnabled off plus diagnostic off recovers exact R02 frames for the held same scene, with the restored scene state unchanged.
Review actual R04 / R02 beauty and semantic images for the requested poses and views; do not convert a displacement or pixel-count threshold into visual acceptance.
Verify current archive download/restore routes and reject malformed R04 state before person changes on the actual candidate.
prohibitedInferences: No exact solver layer is declared to introduce the visible stepped inner rim.
The Kd envelope is not removed or changed: it moved no native-rim vertices in the four diagnosed poses.
The 49 rim pairs use 49 distinct upper and 49 distinct lower vertices for this person; no duplicate-pair defect is asserted.
Pucker and speak local-action neighbor differences identify follow-up candidates only, not a proven visible fold cause.
The new shader source review is not a claim of measured anatomy, full volume scattering, visual success, or production readiness.
